# OsdGeneral (push)

Flight Controller "OSD General Data" push, the main telemetry message. Same class is registered under two cmdset/cmdid pairs in the real app (CmdSet.java): FLYC.GetPushCommon(3,0x43) and OSD.GetPushCommon(9,0x01) both resolve to dji.midware.data.model.P3.DataOsdGetPushCommon.

**Confidence:** U

**Provenance:** dji.midware.data.model.P3.DataOsdGetPushCommon (dji.go.v4 decompile, gitignored, not in this repo). Offsets 0-29 originally from the public o-gs/dji-firmware-tools Wireshark dissector; offsets 30-52 are a byte-for-byte port of the real class's get(offset,len,...) calls. See awto-dji#16.
